decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham builds directly on the firm's core ham know-how and certified organic systems, so it can readily interpret market feedback and refine the product in line with its organic expansion strategy.
Organic Kasseler is a close extension of established curing and smoking expertise within the growing organic line, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to sustain it.
Pepper salami in organic quality relies on the firm's maturation facilities and proprietary seasoning know-how, making it a low-risk, well-understood range item.

The exotic teriyaki aspic stretches beyond traditional recipe knowledge and serves the declining service-counter channel, making its results harder to read, but it still draws on core aspic expertise and is worth a further trial.
Fennel salami (Finocchiona-style) fits the firm's salami competence, though as a flavour variant in a crowded segment it is more likely than the core items to be rotated out.
A classic liver pâté with veal sits squarely within the firm's pâté tradition and recipe know-how, so it is easy to assimilate and maintain.
